atoms.text: Next, Carla is going to show you around some buildings over water around the world.

instruction.text: Select the three images of houses over water.

finish.text: Correct! You can also live in houses on stilts over water or in a houseboat!

feedback.wrong: This is an ancient temple in Greece.

instruction.text: This is a house on stilts in Myanmar. Select the water to learn more.

feedback.end: Myanmar is one of many countries that gets a rainy season. This means flooding is very common, so stilts are used to keep the houses safe from high water levels.

instruction.text: This is an overwater villa in French Polynesia. Select the roof to learn more.

feedback.end: Houses can also be built over shallow water at beaches. These stilts aren’t used as protection against flooding, but instead as a luxury overwater stay for tourists - tourism is very popular in beautiful island locations!

instruction.text: These are houseboats on a canal in the Netherlands. Select the canal to learn more.

feedback.end: The Netherlands has a lot of canals, which are man-made waterways, so people have set up houseboats to live here. They have electricity, kitchens, bedrooms and bathrooms just like any normal house!

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Carla wants to learn more about the houses on stilts in Myanmar. Answer her question.

feedback.end: You can use paper and a pencil to note down your questions and people’s answers.

atoms.a: “Let’s talk with local people to learn what it’s like to live here. What should we bring?“
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_2025'>Let’s talk with local people to learn what it’s like to live here. What should we bring?</voice>

instruction.text: Listen to the options and select the questions Carla could ask.

atoms.a: “I want to learn about how these houses are prepared for heavy rainfall. What should I ask?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_2025'>I want to learn about how these houses are prepared for heavy rainfall. What should I ask?</voice>

b.sound: Do you know what materials your house was built from?
How many pet cats do you have?

atoms.a: “I want to learn about what it’s like to live here. What should I ask?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_2025'>I want to learn about what it’s like to live here. What should I ask?</voice>

b.sound: What are all the good and bad things about this house?

feedback.finish: Great! You can learn a lot about houses and different living situations around the world by talking to people.
